findings.evidence: `pkg/ddl/job_scheduler.go:562` describes maintaining the online-DDL 2-version invariant on restart/owner-change; the non-MDL pre-sync now runs only when `job.LastSchemaVersion > 0` (`pkg/ddl/job_scheduler.go:583`). `Job.Decode` is plain `json.Unmarshal` (`pkg/meta/model/job.go:560`), so older job JSON without `last_schema_version` (`pkg/meta/model/job.go:397`) decodes as 0 and will skip the wait; invariant requirement is also stated in `pkg/ddl/doc.go:23`.
findings.fix: Preserve old behavior for “unknown” jobs: implement custom JSON unmarshal (or a decode wrapper) to detect missing `last_schema_version` and set a sentinel (e.g. `-1`), then in scheduler wait when `LastSchemaVersion != 0` (unknown or >0) and skip only when explicitly 0; alternatively, restrict the skip to `ActionMultiSchemaChange` to reduce rolling-upgrade blast radius.
findings.impact: With `tidb_enable_metadata_lock=off`, resuming a started DDL job created by an older TiDB binary after owner crash/rolling upgrade can skip the required pre-run schema sync, violating the 2-version invariant and potentially causing online-DDL state-machine correctness issues (e.g. inconsistent DML writes/backfill gaps) if the previous owner died after committing a schema-version bump but before sync completed.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Searched `e2e01c59d6..upstream/master` for follow-up changes and found no modifications to `LastSchemaVersion` usage; `upstream/master` still gates non-MDL pre-sync on `job.LastSchemaVersion > 0`.
findings.verify: Unit: decode a historical Job JSON blob without `last_schema_version` and ensure owner-change path still performs non-MDL pre-sync; Integration: run a DDL on an older binary with MDL off, crash owner between commit and version sync, restart with this binary, and confirm schema sync happens before the next online-DDL state transition.
findings.what: Compatibility/correctness risk: in non-MDL mode the restart/owner-change pre-sync is skipped when `job.LastSchemaVersion==0`; for jobs persisted by older TiDB versions (field absent => decoded as 0), this can skip required schema-version synchronization and break the online DDL 2-version invariant.

subject: ddl: skip waiting version synced without MDL for multi-schema-change (#62477)
summary: This commit adds `Job.LastSchemaVersion` and uses it to skip `waitVersionSyncedWithoutMDL` when MDL is off and the last DDL step didn’t bump schema version; it also adds a regression test for multi-schema-change under MDL toggle. One High risk remains: jobs created by older binaries decode `LastSchemaVersion` as 0, which can incorrectly skip the restart/owner-change pre-sync in non-MDL mode and violate the online-DDL 2-version invariant; no later fix found up to `upstream/master`.
